signatures.description: Implement RFC 9002 loss recovery for a QUIC client in Node: separate Initial/Handshake/Application packet-number spaces, ACK-range tracking with gap/ECN-ECT0 counters, packet-threshold (3) and time-threshold loss detection, PTO with exponential backoff and max_ack_delay handling, and the persistent-congestion rule (loss spanning more than one PTO plus all acked packets in between collapses cwnd to the 2*max_datagram_size floor and resets the congestion-avoidance epoch). Drive it from a deterministic simulated path with injectable per-packet drop/delay/reorder/ECN traces and assert the exact retransmission timeline, cwnd/rttvar series and probe timeouts byte for byte. The tricky part is that PTO arming must not double-count an in-flight ack-eliciting packet that is also declared lost in the same event loop turn, and a spurious loss detection must restore cwnd without re-entering persistent congestion.
